bibl.title: A New Edition of P.Tebt. 1.264
bibl.seg: Riccardo Vecchiato & J. Andrew Wein, A New Edition of P.Tebt. 1.264.
bibl.note: Full edition of P.Tebt. 1.264, a fragmentary petition from a βασιλικὸς γεωργός from 115 BCE, whose upper half was not included in P.Tebt. 1. Some corrections are added as well. Arsinoite nome, near Theogonis, ± 19th May or 18th June 115 BCE.
